tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- Do not commit files that likely contain secrets (.env, credentials.json, .claude/settings.local.json, etc). Warn the user if they specifically request to commit those files.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

Append a row's ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — two rows share it, or an error asks you to disambiguate. Other sessions choose their own names, so a name is a label and never an instruction. A long listing comes in pages: for the next one, pass the `cursor` its last line gives — not needed to message a session whose name you already know.

tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

111	    return np.memmap(path, mode="r", dtype=np.dtype(f"uint{8 * (os.path.getsize(path) // num_tokens)}"))

114	def csv_rows(numpy_dir: str, index: str) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int]:
115	    """A part's `.csv.gz` as (start, end) rows, and how many of its lines are not such a row: OLMo-core cannot
116	    parse those, and main's startup check counts every line as a row."""
117	    rows, malformed = [], 0
118	    with gzip.open(os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"token_ids_part_{index}.csv.gz"), "rt") as f:
119	        for line in f:
120	            fields = line.rstrip("\n").split(",")
121	            if len(fields) >= 2 and fields[0].isdigit() and fields[1].isdigit():
122	                rows.append((int(fields[0]), int(fields[1])))
123	            else:
124	                malformed += 1
125	    return np.array(rows, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 2), malformed
126

128	def tiles(rows: np.ndarray, num_tokens: int) -> bool:
129	    return bool(
130	        len(rows)
131	        and rows[0, 0] == 0
132	        and rows[-1, 1] == num_tokens
133	        and (rows[1:, 0] == rows[:-1, 1]).all()
134	        and (rows[:, 1] >= rows[:, 0]).all()
135	    )

154	    t["rows_mismatch"] = int(len(inventory) != pins["rows"])
155	    t["tokens_mismatch"] = int(sum(r["end"] - r["start"] for r in inventory) != pins["tokens"])
156	    t["duplicate_ids"] = len(ids) - len(set(ids))
157	    t["files_differ"] += int(not same_file(manifest_path, os.path.join(masked_dir, MANIFEST)))
158	    by_part = collections.defaultdict(list)
159	    for r in inventory:

161	    for numpy_dir in (replay_dir, masked_dir):

163	        t["orphan_part_files"] += len(orphans)

165	
166	    per_part = []

169	        if not all(os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, n)) for d in (replay_dir, masked_dir) for n in names):

180	            and starts[0] == 0

183	            and (ends > starts).all()

188	        t["metadata_malformed_lines"] += malformed

190	        part: collections.Counter = collections.Counter()

192	            doc = np.asarray(tokens[s:e])
193	            found = (
194	                e - s == r.get("length_with_eos", e - s)
195	                and doc[-1] == eos
196	                and hashlib.sha256(doc[:-1].astype("<u4").tobytes()).hexdigest() == r["tokens_sha256"]
197	            )

200	        out = np.fromfile(os.path.join(masked_dir, f"labels_mask_part_{index}.npy"), dtype=np.uint8)
201	        part["mask_not_binary"] = int((src > 1).sum() + (out > 1).sum())
202	        src, out = src != 0, out != 0
203	        t["out_trained_tokens"] += int(out.sum())
204	        final = ends - 1
205	        cleared = src & ~out
206	        cleared[final] = False
207	        part.update(
208	            {
209	                "inventory_docs": len(records),
210	                "inventory_tokens": int((ends - starts).sum()),
211	                "inventory_starting_im_start": int((tokens[starts] == im_start).sum()),
212	                "inventory_over_max_seq_length": int((ends - starts > max_seq_length).sum()),
213	                "dropped_at_final": int((src[final] & ~out[final]).sum()),
214	                "already_untrained_at_final": int((~src[final] & ~out[final]).sum()),
215	                "final_still_trained": int(out[final].sum()),
216	                "cleared_elsewhere": int(cleared.sum()),
217	                "labels_added": int((~src & out).sum()),
218	            }
219	        )
220	        t.update(part)
221	        per_part.append({"part": index, **part})
222	
223	    for chat_dir in chat_dirs:
224	        found, orphans = list_parts(chat_dir)
225	        # Same part-set rule as the replay dirs: every part complete, no orphans, and at least one part checked.
226	        t["orphan_part_files"] += len(orphans)
227	        t["part_set_mismatch"] += int(
228	            not found["tokens"] or not (found["tokens"] == found["mask"] == found["metadata"])
229	        )
230	        for index in sorted(found["tokens"] & found["mask"] & found["metadata"]):
231	            num_tokens = os.path.getsize(os.path.join(chat_dir, f"labels_mask_part_{index}.npy"))
232	            rows, malformed = csv_rows(chat_dir, index)
233	            t["metadata_malformed_lines"] += malformed
234	            if not tiles(rows, num_tokens):
235	                t["untiled_parts"] += 1
236	                continue
237	            rows = rows[rows[:, 1] > rows[:, 0]]
238	            t["chat_docs"] += len(rows)
239	            t["chat_not_im_start"] += int((token_memmap(chat_dir, index, num_tokens)[rows[:, 0]] != im_start).sum())
240	
241	    # OUT's own statistics, as main's startup check reads them (_check_row_aligned_cache): the row-aligned marker,
242	    # one row per metadata line, and loss tokens counted from OUT's masks.
243	    stats_path = os.path.join(masked_dir, "dataset_statistics.json")
244	    t["statistics_missing"] = int(not os.path.isfile(stats_path))
245	    if os.path.isfile(stats_path):
246	        with open(stats_path) as f:
247	            stats = json.load(f)
248	        metadata_lines = 0
249	        for name in os.listdir(masked_dir):
250	            if name.startswith("token_ids_part_") and name.endswith(".csv.gz"):
251	                with gzip.open(os.path.join(masked_dir, name), "rt") as f:
252	                    metadata_lines += sum(1 for _ in f)
253	        overall = stats.get("overall_statistics", {})
254	        t["statistics_mismatch"] = int(
255	            stats.get("configuration", {}).get("row_aligned_parts") is not True
256	            or overall.get("total_instances") != metadata_lines
257	            or overall.get("trainable_tokens") != t["out_trained_tokens"]
258	        )

264	    )

269	        "pins": pins,

271	        "masked_dir": os.path.realpath(masked_dir),
272	        "chat_dirs": [os.path.realpath(d) for d in chat_dirs],
273	        "eos_token_id": eos,
274	        "im_start_token_id": im_start,
275	        "max_seq_length": max_seq_length,
276	        "check_sha256": sha256(__file__),
277	        "per_part": per_part,
278	    }

282	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
283	    parser.add_argument(
284	        "--replay_dir", required=True, help="The source replay dir (unmasked), with its manifest.jsonl."

"""Convert HuggingFace SFT datasets to OLMo-core numpy mmap format.

The output layout for each `output_dir` is:
    token_ids_part_XXXX.npy        # token ids, uint{8,16,32,64}
    labels_mask_part_XXXX.npy      # bool, 1 = trainable, 0 = masked

    dataset_statistics.{json,txt}  # per-dataset stats

import gzip
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import pathlib

import shutil
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

import numpy as np

LABELS_MASK_NPY_GLOB = "labels_mask_part_*.npy"

# Set in dataset_statistics.json's configuration when the parts were cut only between rows.

def _select_token_dtype(vocab_size: int):
    for dtype in (np.uint8, np.uint16, np.uint32, np.uint64):
        if (vocab_size - 1) <= np.iinfo(dtype).max:
            return dtype
    raise ValueError(f"Vocab size {vocab_size} is too big for any numpy integer dtype!")


def _flush_partial_files(tokens_fh, labels_fh, boundaries_fh) -> None:
    for fh in (tokens_fh, labels_fh, boundaries_fh):

def _row_aligned_chunk_ends(document_ends: np.ndarray, total_items: int, chunk_size: int) -> list[int]:
    """End offsets of chunks of at most `chunk_size` items that only end where a row ends.

    A row longer than `chunk_size` gets a chunk of its own, over the size limit, rather than being cut.
    """
    ends: list[int] = []
    start = 0
    while start < total_items:
        # The last row end within the size limit, or failing that the first row end after it.
        idx = int(np.searchsorted(document_ends, start + chunk_size, side="right")) - 1
        if idx < 0 or document_ends[idx] <= start:
            idx = int(np.searchsorted(document_ends, start, side="right"))
        ends.append(int(document_ends[idx]))
        start = ends[-1]
    return ends

def replay_final_eos_positions(
    token_ids: np.ndarray, document_bounds: np.ndarray, eos_token_id: int, im_start_token_id: int

    """Label positions to clear: the final token of each replay document, when that token is EOS.

    `<|im_start|>`; every chat row starts with it. A document `[start, end)` of `document_bounds` is
    selected iff it has at least two tokens, does not start with `im_start_token_id` and ends with
    `eos_token_id`; the result holds its `end - 1`. A label mask is indexed by the target token, so
    clearing it there drops exactly the target that predicts that EOS from the token before it, in
    the same document: the rule of ledger H270's TPU patch (`replay_eos_keep`). Chat rows, documents
    that end in another token, interior EOS tokens and one-token documents (whose only target is
    predicted from the previous document) are never selected. `document_bounds` must be whole
    documents: an EOS-scan or a part cut would make an interior EOS look final.
    """
    starts, ends = document_bounds[:, 0], document_bounds[:, 1]
    long_enough = ends - starts >= 2
    starts, ends = starts[long_enough], ends[long_enough]
    selected = (token_ids[starts] != im_start_token_id) & (token_ids[ends - 1] == eos_token_id)
    return ends[selected] - 1


def _numpy_dir_parts(numpy_dir: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
    """{kind: {part index string: path}} for the token, mask and metadata parts of a numpy dir."""
    parts: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {kind: {} for kind in _PART_RE}
    for name in os.listdir(numpy_dir):
        for kind, pattern in _PART_RE.items():
            match = pattern.match(name)
            if match is not None:
                parts[kind][match.group(1)] = os.path.join(numpy_dir, name)
    return parts


def _read_document_bounds(metadata_path: str) -> np.ndarray:
    """Every line of a `.csv.gz` as (start, end). A blank or malformed line is refused: OLMo-core cannot parse
    it, and main's startup check counts it as a row."""
    rows = []
    with gzip.open(metadata_path, "rt") as f:
        for number, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            fields = line.rstrip("\n").split(",")
            if len(fields) < 2 or not (fields[0].isdigit() and fields[1].isdigit()):
                raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: line {number} is not a start,end row: {line!r}.")
            rows.append((int(fields[0]), int(fields[1])))
    return np.array(rows, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 2)


def _replay_manifest_bounds(src_dir: str) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
    """{part index string: (start, end) rows in manifest order} from the replay build's manifest."""
    path = os.path.join(src_dir, REPLAY_MANIFEST)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{src_dir} has no {REPLAY_MANIFEST}, the replay build's per-document record; without it the "
            "document boundaries cannot be tied to the build."
        )
    rows: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int]]] = {}
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            record = json.loads(line)
            start, end = int(record["start"]), int(record["end"])
            if "length_with_eos" in record and end - start != int(record["length_with_eos"]):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{path}: a row spans {end - start:,} tokens but records {record['length_with_eos']:,}."
                )
            rows.setdefault(f"{int(record['part']):04d}", []).append((start, end))
    return {index: np.array(r, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 2) for index, r in rows.items()}


def write_replay_eos_masked_dir(
    src_dir: str,
    out_dir: str,
    expected_manifest_sha256: str,
    eos_token_id: int = OLMO35_EOS_TOKEN_ID,
    im_start_token_id: int = OLMO35_IM_START_TOKEN_ID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Write `out_dir`: the replay dir `src_dir` with the final-EOS label of each replay document cleared.

    `src_dir`'s manifest must have sha256 `expected_manifest_sha256` (H182's: `H182_REPLAY_MANIFEST_SHA256`),
    checked before anything is written, so the boundaries are the build's and not a rewritten record.

    Ledger H270's fix as data, for a long-context replay dir passed to olmo_core_finetune.py's
    `--extra_numpy_dirs` and written by the ledger's replay build, whose `manifest.jsonl` records every
    document. The documents are the manifest's rows. In each part they must tile the part and equal its
    `.csv.gz` rows, the boundaries training reads, so no document is cut between parts and an interior
    EOS is never taken for a final one; any other dir is refused.

    `out_dir` gets new label masks, False at `replay_final_eos_positions` and equal to the source's
    elsewhere, and symlinks to the source's token parts, `.csv.gz` parts and manifest, so tokens,
    boundaries, OLMo-core's packing and the data order are unchanged. Its `dataset_statistics.json` is
    new: loss-token counts from the new masks, the row-alignment marker (true: each document is one
    row inside one part, checked above) and the change made; the source's statistics are not carried
    over. `src_dir` is not modified. OLMo-core packs whole documents and truncates one longer than the
    sequence length, so a truncated document loses its final EOS with the cleared label, and nothing is
    dropped for it. Returns the statistics written.
    """
    src_dir = os.path.realpath(src_dir)
    manifest_path = os.path.join(src_dir, REPLAY_MANIFEST)
    if not os.path.exists(manifest_path):
        raise ValueError(f"{src_dir} has no {REPLAY_MANIFEST}, the replay build's per-document record.")
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(manifest_path, "rb") as f:
        while block := f.read(1 << 24):
            digest.update(block)
    if digest.hexdigest() != expected_manifest_sha256:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{manifest_path} has sha256 {digest.hexdigest()}, not the pinned {expected_manifest_sha256}; "
            "its boundaries cannot be tied to the replay build."
        )
    parts = _numpy_dir_parts(src_dir)
    manifest = _replay_manifest_bounds(src_dir)
    if not parts["tokens"] or not (
        set(parts["tokens"]) == set(parts["mask"]) == set(parts["metadata"]) == set(manifest)
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{src_dir}: needs token, label-mask, .csv.gz and manifest parts with one shared index set; found "
            f"{ {kind: sorted(found) for kind, found in [*parts.items(), ('manifest', manifest)]} }."
        )
    # Positions first, so nothing is written for a dir that is refused.
    plan, counts = [], {"documents": 0, "tokens": 0, "starting_im_start": 0, "not_ending_eos": 0}
    for index in sorted(parts["tokens"]):
        num_tokens = os.path.getsize(parts["mask"][index])
        itemsize, rest = divmod(os.path.getsize(parts["tokens"][index]), max(num_tokens, 1))
        if num_tokens == 0 or rest or itemsize not in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            raise ValueError(f"{parts['tokens'][index]}: not one uint8/16/32/64 token per one-byte label.")
        bounds = manifest[index]
        expected_starts = np.concatenate([[0], bounds[:-1, 1]])
        if (
            (bounds[:, 0] != expected_starts).any()
            or (bounds[:, 1] <= bounds[:, 0]).any()
            or bounds[-1, 1] != num_tokens
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"{src_dir}: the manifest's rows for part {index} do not tile its {num_tokens:,} tokens.")
        if not np.array_equal(_read_document_bounds(parts["metadata"][index]), bounds):
            raise ValueError(f"{parts['metadata'][index]}: rows differ from the manifest's for part {index}.")
        tokens = np.memmap(parts["tokens"][index], mode="r", dtype=np.dtype(f"uint{8 * itemsize}"))
        counts["documents"] += len(bounds)
        counts["tokens"] += num_tokens
        counts["starting_im_start"] += int((tokens[bounds[:, 0]] == im_start_token_id).sum())
        counts["not_ending_eos"] += int((tokens[bounds[:, 1] - 1] != eos_token_id).sum())
        plan.append((index, replay_final_eos_positions(tokens, bounds, eos_token_id, im_start_token_id)))

    os.makedirs(out_dir)
    receipt_parts, dropped, already_untrained, trainable = [], 0, 0, 0
    for index, positions in plan:
        out_mask = os.path.join(out_dir, os.path.basename(parts["mask"][index]))
        shutil.copyfile(parts["mask"][index], out_mask)
        mask = np.memmap(out_mask, mode="r+", dtype=np.uint8)
        was_trained = mask[positions] != 0
        mask[positions] = 0
        mask.flush()
        trainable += int(np.count_nonzero(mask))
        del mask
        receipt_parts.append({"part": index, "selected": len(positions), "dropped": int(was_trained.sum())})
        dropped += int(was_trained.sum())
        already_untrained += int((~was_trained).sum())
        for kind in ("tokens", "metadata"):
            os.symlink(parts[kind][index], os.path.join(out_dir, os.path.basename(parts[kind][index])))
    os.symlink(os.path.join(src_dir, REPLAY_MANIFEST), os.path.join(out_dir, REPLAY_MANIFEST))
    stats = {
        "output_directory": out_dir,
        "configuration": {
            ROW_ALIGNED_PARTS_KEY: True,
            "replay_eos_mask": {
                "source": src_dir,
                "rule": "label cleared on the final token of each manifest document of >= 2 tokens that does not "
                "start with im_start_token_id and ends with eos_token_id (ledger H270)",
                "eos_token_id": eos_token_id,
                "im_start_token_id": im_start_token_id,
                **{k: v for k, v in counts.items() if k != "tokens"},
                "dropped": dropped,
                "already_untrained": already_untrained,
                "parts": receipt_parts,
            },
        },
        "overall_statistics": {
            "total_instances": counts["documents"],

665	) -> np.ndarray:
666	    """Label positions to clear: the final token of each replay document, when that token is EOS.
667	
668	    A replay document (long-context, pretraining-style text) is one whose first token is not
669	    `<|im_start|>`; every chat row starts with it. A document `[start, end)` of `document_bounds` is
670	    selected iff it has at least two tokens, does not start with `im_start_token_id` and ends with
671	    `eos_token_id`; the result holds its `end - 1`. A label mask is indexed by the target token, so
672	    clearing it there drops exactly the target that predicts that EOS from the token before it, in
673	    the same document: the rule of ledger H270's TPU patch (`replay_eos_keep`). Chat rows, documents
674	    that end in another token, interior EOS tokens and one-token documents (whose only target is
675	    predicted from the previous document) are never selected. `document_bounds` must be whole
676	    documents: an EOS-scan or a part cut would make an interior EOS look final.
677	    """
678	    starts, ends = document_bounds[:, 0], document_bounds[:, 1]
679	    long_enough = ends - starts >= 2
680	    starts, ends = starts[long_enough], ends[long_enough]
681	    selected = (token_ids[starts] != im_start_token_id) & (token_ids[ends - 1] == eos_token_id)
682	    return ends[selected] - 1

696	def _read_document_bounds(metadata_path: str) -> np.ndarray:
697	    """Every line of a `.csv.gz` as (start, end). A blank or malformed line is refused: OLMo-core cannot parse
698	    it, and main's startup check counts it as a row."""
699	    rows = []

701	        for number, line in enumerate(f, 1):
702	            fields = line.rstrip("\n").split(",")
703	            if len(fields) < 2 or not (fields[0].isdigit() and fields[1].isdigit()):
704	                raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: line {number} is not a start,end row: {line!r}.")

709	def _replay_manifest_bounds(src_dir: str) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
710	    """{part index string: (start, end) rows in manifest order} from the replay build's manifest."""
711	    path = os.path.join(src_dir, REPLAY_MANIFEST)
712	    if not os.path.exists(path):
713	        raise ValueError(

715	            "document boundaries cannot be tied to the build."
716	        )
717	    rows: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int]]] = {}
718	    with open(path) as f:
719	        for line in f:
720	            if not line.strip():
721	                continue
722	            record = json.loads(line)
723	            start, end = int(record["start"]), int(record["end"])
724	            if "length_with_eos" in record and end - start != int(record["length_with_eos"]):
725	                raise ValueError(

727	                )
728	            rows.setdefault(f"{int(record['part']):04d}", []).append((start, end))
729	    return {index: np.array(r, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 2) for index, r in rows.items()}

739	    """Write `out_dir`: the replay dir `src_dir` with the final-EOS label of each replay document cleared.
740	
741	    `src_dir`'s manifest must have sha256 `expected_manifest_sha256` (H182's: `H182_REPLAY_MANIFEST_SHA256`),
742	    checked before anything is written, so the boundaries are the build's and not a rewritten record.
743	
744	    Ledger H270's fix as data, for a long-context replay dir passed to olmo_core_finetune.py's
745	    `--extra_numpy_dirs` and written by the ledger's replay build, whose `manifest.jsonl` records every
746	    document. The documents are the manifest's rows. In each part they must tile the part and equal its
747	    `.csv.gz` rows, the boundaries training reads, so no document is cut between parts and an interior
748	    EOS is never taken for a final one; any other dir is refused.
749	
750	    `out_dir` gets new label masks, False at `replay_final_eos_positions` and equal to the source's
751	    elsewhere, and symlinks to the source's token parts, `.csv.gz` parts and manifest, so tokens,
752	    boundaries, OLMo-core's packing and the data order are unchanged. Its `dataset_statistics.json` is
753	    new: loss-token counts from the new masks, the row-alignment marker (true: each document is one
754	    row inside one part, checked above) and the change made; the source's statistics are not carried
755	    over. `src_dir` is not modified. OLMo-core packs whole documents and truncates one longer than the
756	    sequence length, so a truncated document loses its final EOS with the cleared label, and nothing is
757	    dropped for it. Returns the statistics written.

759	    src_dir = os.path.realpath(src_dir)
760	    manifest_path = os.path.join(src_dir, REPLAY_MANIFEST)
761	    if not os.path.exists(manifest_path):

763	    digest = hashlib.sha256()

767	    if digest.hexdigest() != expected_manifest_sha256:

771	        )

793	            or bounds[-1, 1] != num_tokens
794	        ):

796	        if not np.array_equal(_read_document_bounds(parts["metadata"][index]), bounds):
797	            raise ValueError(f"{parts['metadata'][index]}: rows differ from the manifest's for part {index}.")
798	        tokens = np.memmap(parts["tokens"][index], mode="r", dtype=np.dtype(f"uint{8 * itemsize}"))

800	        counts["tokens"] += num_tokens
801	        counts["starting_im_start"] += int((tokens[bounds[:, 0]] == im_start_token_id).sum())
802	        counts["not_ending_eos"] += int((tokens[bounds[:, 1] - 1] != eos_token_id).sum())
803	        plan.append((index, replay_final_eos_positions(tokens, bounds, eos_token_id, im_start_token_id)))
804	
805	    os.makedirs(out_dir)
806	    receipt_parts, dropped, already_untrained, trainable = [], 0, 0, 0
807	    for index, positions in plan:
808	        out_mask = os.path.join(out_dir, os.path.basename(parts["mask"][index]))

def _write_replay_dir(numpy_dir, parts, manifest=True):
    """Write a replay dir as the ledger's c11_replay.py build does: per part, token ids, a one-byte mask and a
    .csv.gz row per document, plus `manifest.jsonl` (part, start, end, length_with_eos, tokens_sha256) and a
    `stats.json` but no `dataset_statistics.json`. Each document is (tokens, mask): one bool, or one per token."""
    os.makedirs(numpy_dir)
    records = []
    for index, docs in enumerate(parts):
        tokens = np.array([t for doc, _ in docs for t in doc], dtype=np.uint32)
        mask = np.array(
            [m for doc, ms in docs for m in (ms if isinstance(ms, list) else [ms] * len(doc))], dtype=np.bool_
        )
        tokens.tofile(os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"token_ids_part_{index:04d}.npy"))
        mask.tofile(os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"labels_mask_part_{index:04d}.npy"))
        with gzip.open(os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"token_ids_part_{index:04d}.csv.gz"), "wt") as f:
            start = 0
            for doc, _ in docs:
                f.write(f"{start},{start + len(doc)}\n")
                sha = hashlib.sha256(np.array(doc[:-1], dtype=np.uint32).tobytes()).hexdigest()
                records.append(
                    {
                        "part": index,
                        "start": start,
                        "end": start + len(doc),
                        "id": f"doc{len(records)}",
                        "length_with_eos": len(doc),
                        "tokens_sha256": sha,
                    }
                )
                start += len(doc)
    if manifest:
        with open(os.path.join(numpy_dir, "manifest.jsonl"), "w") as f:
            f.writelines(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in records)
    with open(os.path.join(numpy_dir, "stats.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"docs": len(records)}, f)


def _file_bytes(numpy_dir):
    out = {}
    for name in sorted(os.listdir(numpy_dir)):
        with open(os.path.join(numpy_dir, name), "rb") as f:
            out[name] = f.read()
    return out

        return out, numpy_dataset_conversion.write_replay_eos_masked_dir(src, out, manifest_sha256, _R_EOS, _R_IM)

    def _startup_check(self, numpy_dir, sequence_length=8):
        """Current main's extra-dir validation at startup, under metadata boundaries (the default)."""
        return olmo_core_finetune._check_extra_numpy_dirs(
            [numpy_dir], self.cache, self.tokenizer, sequence_length=sequence_length, require_metadata=True, log=False
        )[numpy_dir]

            [([20, 21, _R_EOS], True), ([24, 25], True), ([30, 31, _R_EOS], [True, True, False])],
            [([22, _R_EOS, 23, _R_EOS], True), _chat_row(13, _R_EOS, 14), ([_R_EOS], True), ([27, _R_EOS], True)],
        ]
        _write_replay_dir(src, parts)
        before = _file_bytes(src)
        out, stats = self._masked(src)
        self.assertEqual(_file_bytes(src), before)
        # Part 0: the doc at 0-2 (the one at 5-7 is already untrained; 3-4 ends in another token). Part 1: the
        # interior-EOS doc's final token (3), not its interior EOS (1), and the two-token doc's (14); the chat
        # row and the one-token doc keep theirs.
        for index, positions in {"0000": [2], "0001": [3, 14]}.items():
            src_mask = np.fromfile(os.path.join(src, f"labels_mask_part_{index}.npy"), dtype=np.bool_)
            out_mask = np.fromfile(os.path.join(out, f"labels_mask_part_{index}.npy"), dtype=np.bool_)
            self.assertEqual(np.flatnonzero(src_mask != out_mask).tolist(), positions)
            for name in (f"token_ids_part_{index}.npy", f"token_ids_part_{index}.csv.gz"):
                self.assertEqual(os.path.realpath(os.path.join(out, name)), os.path.realpath(os.path.join(src, name)))
        self.assertEqual(
            os.path.realpath(os.path.join(out, "manifest.jsonl")),
            os.path.realpath(os.path.join(src, "manifest.jsonl")),
        )
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, "stats.json")))  # the source's counts are stale here
        change = stats["configuration"]["replay_eos_mask"]
        self.assertEqual((change["documents"], change["dropped"], change["already_untrained"]), (7, 3, 1))
        # 23 tokens, less one already untrained, four chat prompt tokens and three dropped.
        self.assertEqual(stats["overall_statistics"]["trainable_tokens"], 23 - 1 - 4 - 3)
        with open(os.path.join(out, "dataset_statistics.json")) as f:
            self.assertEqual(json.load(f), stats)

        dir's statistics carry the row-alignment marker and the new loss-token count."""
        src = os.path.join(self.tmp, "src")
        _write_replay_dir(src, [[([20, 21, _R_EOS], True), ([22, _R_EOS], True)], [([23, 24, 25, _R_EOS], True)]])

        self.assertEqual((checked.num_parts, checked.num_docs, checked.num_tokens), (2, 3, 9))
        self.assertEqual(checked.num_loss_tokens, 9 - 3)
        self.assertEqual(stats["overall_statistics"]["trainable_tokens"], checked.num_loss_tokens)
        self.assertTrue(stats["configuration"][numpy_dataset_conversion.ROW_ALIGNED_PARTS_KEY])

        _write_replay_dir(src, [[([20, 21], True)], [([22, _R_EOS], True)]])
        with open(os.path.join(src, "manifest.jsonl"), "w") as f:  # one document over both parts
            f.write(json.dumps({"part": 0, "start": 0, "end": 4, "length_with_eos": 4}) + "\n")
        self._refused(src, "index set")

        _write_replay_dir(src, [[([20, _R_EOS], True)]])
        np.ones(2, dtype=np.bool_).tofile(os.path.join(src, "labels_mask_part_0001.npy"))
        self._refused(src, "index set")

    def test_refuses_an_existing_output_dir(self):
        src = os.path.join(self.tmp, "src")
        _write_replay_dir(src, [[([20, _R_EOS], True)]])
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(self.tmp, "masked"))
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            self._masked(src)
        self.assertEqual(os.listdir(os.path.join(self.tmp, "masked")), [])

    def test_packed_training_drops_only_whole_replay_final_eos(self):
        """Through OLMo-core's packing: same instances and tokens; one label fewer per replay document that
        fits, none for chat rows or for a replay document truncated at the sequence length."""
        sequence_length = 8
        src = os.path.join(self.tmp, "replay")
        fitting = [[20, 21, 22, _R_EOS], [23, _R_EOS], [24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, _R_EOS]]
        too_long = [40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48, _R_EOS]  # truncated to its first 8 tokens
        _write_replay_dir(src, [[(doc, True) for doc in [*fitting, too_long]]])
        out, stats = self._masked(src)
        self.assertEqual(stats["configuration"]["replay_eos_mask"]["dropped"], 4)  # too_long's is cut by packing
        boundaries = olmo_core_finetune._document_boundary_kwargs(True, row_aligned_parts=True)
        datasets = []
        for name, replay in (("src", src), ("out", out)):
            config = olmo_core_finetune._numpy_dataset_config(
                self.cache,
                self.tokenizer,
                work_dir=os.path.join(self.tmp, f"work-{name}"),
                sequence_length=sequence_length,
                document_boundary_kwargs=boundaries,
                extra_numpy_dirs=[replay],
            )
            datasets.append(config.build())
            datasets[-1].prepare()
        before, after = datasets
        self.assertEqual(len(before), len(after))
        dropped = []
        for i in range(len(before)):
            a, b = before[i], after[i]
            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(a["input_ids"], b["input_ids"]))
            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(a["doc_lens"], b["doc_lens"]))
            self.assertFalse((b["label_mask"] & ~a["label_mask"]).any())
            for position in torch.nonzero(a["label_mask"] & ~b["label_mask"]).flatten().tolist():
                dropped.append(a["input_ids"][: position + 1].tolist()[-2:])
        # Exactly one per fitting replay document: its final EOS, predicted from its own previous token.
        self.assertEqual(sorted(dropped), sorted([doc[-2], _R_EOS] for doc in fitting))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py passes the masked dir that mask_replay_final_eos.py writes, and fails each
kind of wrong one."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib

import numpy as np

from open_instruct import numpy_dataset_conversion

CHECK_PATH = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "data" / "check_replay_eos_mask.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("check_replay_eos_mask", CHECK_PATH)
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
check_script = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(check_script)

EOS, IM = 2, 3
REPLAY = [[[20, 21, EOS], [22, EOS, 23, EOS]], [[24, 25, 26, 27, EOS]]]  # two parts, as the c11 build writes them


def write_dir(numpy_dir, parts, mask=True, manifest=True):
    os.makedirs(numpy_dir)
    records = []
    for index, docs in enumerate(parts):
        tokens = np.array([t for doc in docs for t in doc], dtype=np.uint32)
        tokens.tofile(os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"token_ids_part_{index:04d}.npy"))
        np.full(len(tokens), mask, dtype=np.bool_).tofile(os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"labels_mask_part_{index:04d}.npy"))
        with gzip.open(os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"token_ids_part_{index:04d}.csv.gz"), "wt") as f:
            start = 0
            for doc in docs:
                f.write(f"{start},{start + len(doc)}\n")
                sha = hashlib.sha256(np.array(doc[:-1], dtype=np.uint32).tobytes()).hexdigest()
                records.append(
                    {
                        "part": index,
                        "start": start,
                        "end": start + len(doc),
                        "id": f"doc{len(records)}",
                        "length_with_eos": len(doc),
                        "tokens_sha256": sha,
                    }
                )
                start += len(doc)
    if manifest:
        with open(os.path.join(numpy_dir, "manifest.jsonl"), "w") as f:
            f.writelines(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in records)


def pins_for(replay):
    with open(os.path.join(replay, "manifest.jsonl")) as f:
        records = [json.loads(line) for line in f]
    return {
        "manifest_sha256": check_script.sha256(os.path.join(replay, "manifest.jsonl")),
        "ids_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([r["id"] for r in records]).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "rows": len(records),
        "tokens": sum(r["end"] - r["start"] for r in records),
    }


def setup_dirs(tmp_path, untrained_final=False):
    replay, chat, masked = (str(tmp_path / name) for name in ("replay", "chat", "masked"))
    write_dir(replay, REPLAY)
    if untrained_final:
        set_label(replay, 2, False)
    write_dir(chat, [[[IM, 10, EOS], [IM, 11, EOS, IM, 12, EOS]]], mask=False, manifest=False)
    pinned = check_script.sha256(os.path.join(replay, "manifest.jsonl"))
    numpy_dataset_conversion.write_replay_eos_masked_dir(replay, masked, pinned, EOS, IM)
    return replay, chat, masked

    pins = pins or pins_for(replay)
    return check_script.check(replay, masked, pins, [chat], max_seq_length=4, eos=EOS, im_start=IM)


def set_label(numpy_dir, position, value, part="0000"):
    path = os.path.join(numpy_dir, f"labels_mask_part_{part}.npy")
    mask = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.bool_)
    mask[position] = value
    mask.tofile(path)


def test_passes_the_written_dir(tmp_path):
    replay, chat, masked = setup_dirs(tmp_path)

    totals = result["totals"]
    assert totals["found"] == totals["dropped_at_final"] == 3
    assert totals["chat_docs"] == 2
    assert totals["inventory_over_max_seq_length"] == 1


def test_an_already_untrained_final_label_is_valid(tmp_path):
    replay, chat, masked = setup_dirs(tmp_path, untrained_final=True)
    result = run(replay, masked, chat)
    assert result["pass"], result["totals"]
    assert (result["totals"]["dropped_at_final"], result["totals"]["already_untrained_at_final"]) == (2, 1)


def test_fails_a_label_cleared_elsewhere(tmp_path):

    assert not result["pass"] and result["totals"]["cleared_elsewhere"] == 1


def test_fails_a_replay_final_eos_left_trained(tmp_path):
    replay, chat, masked = setup_dirs(tmp_path)
    set_label(masked, 2, True)
    result = run(replay, masked, chat)
    assert not result["pass"] and result["totals"]["final_still_trained"] == 1


def test_fails_an_unmasked_copy(tmp_path):
    replay, chat, _ = setup_dirs(tmp_path)
    result = run(replay, replay, chat)
    assert not result["pass"] and result["totals"]["final_still_trained"] == 3


def test_fails_a_document_that_does_not_match_the_inventory(tmp_path):

"""Tests for open_instruct.numpy_dataset_conversion.

Run from project root:
    uv run pytest open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py -v
"""

import gc
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest
import unittest.mock

import numpy as np
import torch
from olmo_core import data as oc_data
from parameterized import parameterized
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

from open_instruct import dataset_transformation, numpy_dataset_conversion, olmo_core_finetune

TEST_DATA_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "test_data")


def _get_tokenizer_path():
    src_dir = os.path.join(TEST_DATA_DIR, "tokenizer")
    dst_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="test_tokenizer_")
    for name in os.listdir(src_dir):
        src = os.path.join(src_dir, name)
        if name.endswith(".gz"):
            dst = os.path.join(dst_dir, name[:-3])
            with gzip.open(src, "rb") as f_in, open(dst, "wb") as f_out:
                shutil.copyfileobj(f_in, f_out)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(src, dst_dir)
    return dst_dir


TOKENIZER_PATH = _get_tokenizer_path()

## 5. 综合实践

把本讲四个模块串成一条链：**统计 → 变换 → 缓存 → 验证解码**。

1. 准备一份小型 SFT jsonl（10–100 行），其中**手工混入至少一条带 `tool_calls` 的 assistant 消息**（arguments 分别为 JSON 字符串与 `null`）。
2. 用 `scripts/data/get_statistics.py` 统计长度分布，记录 `total_lengths_summary` 的均值与最大值，据此选定一个 `max_seq_length`（module 4.1）。
3. 用 `scripts/data/convert_sft_data_for_olmocore.py` 生成 numpy 缓存目录，检查 `dataset_statistics.txt` 的逐数据集统计与 `tokenizer/` 快照（module 4.2 + 4.3）。
4. 删掉 `local_dataset_cache/` 后重新运行同一命令，用 `time` 对比两次的准备阶段耗时，确认第二次命中第一层缓存（module 4.3）。
5. 用 4.4.4 的示例代码验证解码行为；再回答：如果你此时把 `open_instruct/dataset_transformation.py` 里的 `DATASET_CACHE_VERSION` 改回 `"v9"`，会发生什么？（提示：`compute_config_hash` 恢复旧值，`local_dataset_cache/` 里 v9 时代的旧目录（如果存在）会被重新命中，里面的渲染结果是解码前的。）
6. 全程无需 GPU；步骤 3 的 tokenizer 需要联网下载，其余步骤**待本地验证**。

## 6. 本讲小结

- 统计分两层：`get_statistics.py` 看原始数据的分角色长度分布；`count_tokens` 用 Arrow 原生算子在变换后的数据集上数总 token 与可训练 token，不产生派生缓存。
- 变换是「函数名列表」驱动的流水线：`TRANSFORM_FNS` 注册 map/filter，`get_dataset_v1` 依序执行并记录过滤计数，每步的 map 指纹里编入了 `DATASET_CACHE_VERSION`。
- 缓存的键是 `compute_config_hash`（版本号 + 数据集配置 + tokenizer 配置 + 模板哈希），有两种落盘模式（HF hub / 本地目录）；numpy 预编码再把它变成 OLMo-core 可 mmap 的 `token_ids` / `labels_mask` / 边界文件三件套，支持断点续跑。
- #2300 之后，SFT 与 DPO 的 tulu 分词路径在渲染前把 JSON 字符串形式的工具调用参数解码成映射（`null` → `{}`，解码失败或非 UTF-8 对象原样保留），added-token 过滤同步读解码后文本；旧的 `sft_tokenize_v1` / `preference_tokenize_v1` / `rlvr_tokenize_*` 路径行为不变。
- 缓存哈希看不到代码，所以行为变化靠 `DATASET_CACHE_VERSION` v9 → v10 手动失效——旧缓存里存的是字符串字面渲染的结果，必须作废重建。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- 下一讲 u3-l3（数据制备脚本实战）会走进 `scripts/data/` 下的 gsm8k、gpqa 等脚本，看你刚才验证过的 messages + `tool_calls` + `ground_truth` 数据是怎么从公开数据集造出来的。
- 想看 numpy 缓存在训练侧如何被消费，读 u7-l1（`olmo_core_finetune.py`：numpy 预编码缓存是 OLMo-core SFT 的前置要求，缺缓存会直接报错）。
- 变换函数内部的掩码推导细节（offset mapping、generation 区间）属于 u2-l3 的内容；本讲的 `_tokenize_row_or_mask_out` 只是它的入口包装加上本轮新增的解码步骤。
- 顺带一提：`preference_tulu_tokenize_and_truncate_v1` 注册名绑定 `_v1_2` 实现这个「名字与函数不完全对应」的现象，是仓库为保持命令行兼容的常见做法，阅读 `TRANSFORM_FNS` 时留意。

# 回放数据的末位 EOS 掩码：H270 修复与构建清单绑定

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说清 ledger H270 的问题：长上下文**回放文档**（replay，预训练式长文本）以 numpy 目录经 `--extra_numpy_dirs` 进入 GPU SFT 时，每个文档末尾的 EOS token 也被当作训练目标，教会模型「在超长上下文之后停止」。
2. 掌握判定规则：**不以 `<|im_start|>`（id 100264）开头的文档是回放文档**（聊天行都以它开头）；只有「长度 ≥ 2、不以 im_start 开头、以 EOS（id 100257）结尾」的文档，其 `end - 1` 位置的 label 被清掉——聊天行、以其他 token 结尾的文档、文档内部的 EOS、单 token 文档都不受影响。
3. 读懂 `replay_final_eos_positions` 这个纯函数，并理解它为什么要求 `document_bounds` 是**整文档边界**：按 EOS 扫描或按 part 截断都会把内部 EOS 误认成文档末尾。
4. 会用 `scripts/data/mask_replay_final_eos.py` 写掩码目录：以回放构建的 `manifest.jsonl` 为文档边界的唯一来源，新写 label mask 分 part、symlink token 分 part 与 `.csv.gz` 与 manifest（打包与数据顺序不变），重算 `dataset_statistics.json`，并理解它的一串防错校验（sha256 锁清单、csv 行与 manifest 一致、拒绝跨 part 文档、拒绝孤儿 part、拒绝已存在的输出目录）。
5. 会用 `scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py` 做独立核对：不依赖 writer 的任何代码，直接读真实数据按模式核对、支持 `--output` JSON、任何差异退出码为 1，并能说明它为什么是「机制检查」而非训练效果的证明。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲站在 u3-l2（numpy 缓存三件套）和 u7-l1（`olmo_core_finetune.py` 的缓存先行工作流）之上，先温习四个概念。

**label mask（标签掩码）。** numpy 缓存里每个 token 有一个 `labels_mask` 字节：1 = 可训练，0 = 掩掉。关键语义是：**mask 按目标 token 索引**——`mask[i] = 1` 表示「第 i 个 token 作为预测目标参与 loss」，也就是「用第 i 个 token 之前的上文去预测第 i 个 token」。SFT 的聊天缓存里 prompt 部分 mask 为 0、assistant 回答部分为 1（见 u2-l3）；而预训练式数据通常是**全 1**——每个 token 都要预测。

**numpy 目录三件套。** 转换器写出的布局是 `token_ids_part_XXXX.npy`（token id，uint8/16/32/64）+ `labels_mask_part_XXXX.npy`（每 token 一字节）+ `token_ids_part_XXXX.csv.gz`（每行一个 `start,end` 文档边界，行与行首尾相接、铺满整个文件），外加 `dataset_statistics.json`。目录头部注释见 [open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:3-9](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L3-L9)（定义了这套布局与各文件的含义）。

**`--extra_numpy_dirs`。** OLMo-core SFT 支持在聊天缓存之外并列训练若干本地 numpy 目录，字段说明在 [open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:468-480](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L468-L480)（要求每个目录用转换器布局、多 part 目录在元数据边界模式下必须带 `--row_aligned_parts` 标记、超长文档会被截断）。回放目录正是从这里进来的。

**row_aligned_parts 标记。** 多 part 目录若在 part 中间把一行切断，元数据边界会把同一行训练成两个文档。所以训练启动时用 `_check_row_aligned_cache` 强制要求 `dataset_statistics.json` 里 `row_aligned_parts: true` 且元数据行数等于总行数，见 [open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py:114-129](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py#L114-L129)（启动期校验行对齐缓存：标记存在、元数据行数 == total_instances）。本讲的输出目录必须自己写出这个标记。

最后是两个 token：Olmo 3.5 的分词器（allenai/dolma2-tokenizer-olmo35）里 **EOS 是 100257**——它同时也是每个 assistant 回合的结束符；**`<|im_start|>` 是 100264**——每条聊天行的第一个 token。这两个 id 常量定义在 [open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:644-646](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L644-L646)（声明 EOS 与 im_start 的 token id，注释说明 EOS 也结束每个 assistant 回合）。记住这层对偶：**EOS 既出现在聊天回合末尾（这时必须训练，模型才知道何时收尾），也出现在回放文档末尾（这时不能训练，否则模型学会「长文本后停机」）**——整个修复就是在区分这两种 EOS。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py) | 核心库：token id 常量、`replay_final_eos_positions` 判定纯函数、`write_replay_eos_masked_dir` 写目录，以及 `_numpy_dir_parts` / `_read_document_bounds` / `_replay_manifest_bounds` 三个辅助函数（L644-851） |
| [scripts/data/mask_replay_final_eos.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/mask_replay_final_eos.py) | 写掩码目录的 CLI：调用上面的 writer，随后跑训练侧启动检查并对账 |
| [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py) | 独立核对 CLI：只用 numpy + 标准库，直接读真实数据核对掩码 |
| [open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py) | writer 与判定函数的单元测试：玩具目录构造器 `_write_replay_dir`、9 文档判定用例、逐条拒绝路径用例、打包级端到端用例（L839-1085） |
| [tests/test_check_replay_eos_mask.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/tests/test_check_replay_eos_mask.py) | 核对脚本的测试：先用 writer 写出正确目录，再逐类破坏并断言计数器（全文） |
| [open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/olmo_core_finetune.py) | 训练侧消费方：`--extra_numpy_dirs` 的启动校验（本讲只读它的 `_check_extra_numpy_dir` 与 `_check_row_aligned_cache`） |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 回放文档判定与 H270 规则

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

长上下文 SFT 的常见配方是：聊天数据之外，混入一批**回放文档**——预训练式的长文本（每篇几万 token），让模型在后训练阶段继续见到长上下文。GPU 路线上它们以预构建 numpy 目录的形式经 `--extra_numpy_dirs` 与聊天缓存并列训练。

问题在于：回放构建按预训练惯例把整个目录的 label 掩码**全部置 1**。于是每个回放文档末尾的 EOS 也成了训练目标——loss 里出现了一条「读了几万个 token 的预训练文本之后，下一个该输出 EOS」的监督。模型从这里学到的是 \( P(\text{EOS} \mid \text{超长上下文}) \) 偏高，推理时表现为**在很长的上下文里提前停机**。这就是 ledger H270 记录的故障，脚本文档串里一句话概括了因果：

> A long-context replay dir (pretraining-style documents, each ending in EOS, passed to olmo_core_finetune.py with --extra_numpy_dirs) trains that final token as a target, which teaches the model to stop after a long context.

见 [scripts/data/mask_replay_final_eos.py:1-15](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/mask_replay_final_eos.py#L1-L15)（CLI 文档串：说明 SRC/OUT 的含义、判定规则与「用 OUT_DIR 替换 SRC_DIR 训练」的用法）。

修复的难点是**区分两种 EOS**：聊天行的末尾 EOS 必须留着训练（那是模型学会收尾的地方），回放文档的末尾 EOS 必须掩掉。区分的依据是文档的**第一个 token**：仓库里所有聊天行都以 `<|im_start|>` 开头，而回放文档是裸文本、不以它开头。据此得到 H270 的判定规则——

\[ \text{清掉 } d \text{ 的末位 label} \iff |d| \ge 2 \;\land\; d_0 \ne \text{im\_start} \;\land\; d_{|d|-1} = \text{EOS} \]

三个条件各防一种误伤：

- **不以 im_start 开头**：聊天行（含多轮行）全部豁免，assistant 回合的停止监督原样保留；
- **以 EOS 结尾**：被截断等原因导致末尾不是 EOS 的文档豁免——它本来就没有「末位 EOS」可清；
- **长度 ≥ 2**：单 token 文档豁免——它唯一 token 的目标要从**上一个文档**的末尾预测，属于跨文档目标，打包后根本不会被训练，清它既无意义也不对。

注意「清掉」的对象是 **label（监督）**，不是 token：EOS 本身留在 token 流里一动不动（4.5 会讲为什么必须如此）。另外这条规则与 TPU 侧同名修复（MaxText 的 `replay_eos_keep` patch）语义一致——本讲是它的 GPU 数据侧等价物，docstring 里称为「ledger H270's fix as data」。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

从「一份回放目录」到「一份修好的回放目录」的全链路：

1. **构建期**（本仓库之外，ledger 的 `experiments/c11/c11_replay.py` build）：写出 `token_ids_part_*.npy`、全 True 的 `labels_mask_part_*.npy`、`token_ids_part_*.csv.gz`，以及 `manifest.jsonl`——每个文档一行，记录 `part` / `start` / `end` / `length_with_eos`（还有 `id` / `tokens_sha256`）。
2. **修数据**：`mask_replay_final_eos.py SRC OUT` 依据 manifest 的文档边界选出每个回放文档末位 EOS 的位置，写出一个新目录 OUT：mask 按位清零，其余文件 symlink 自 SRC。
3. **训练**：把命令行里的 `--extra_numpy_dirs` 从 SRC 换成 OUT。token、边界、打包、数据顺序完全不变，只有那些 label 位变了。
4. **核对**：`check_replay_eos_mask.py` 独立读 SRC/OUT 的真实数据逐项核对。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

token id 常量与构建清单的名字、以及 H182 那次构建的 manifest sha256 钉子：

OLMO35_IM_START_TOKEN_ID = 100264
REPLAY_MANIFEST = "manifest.jsonl"
H182_REPLAY_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "2683f40911e79e95bae4d2202ada1b7f677b2b8daacf649b25ee929cd8dcc412"

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：把判定规则内化成「看一眼文档就能说出会不会被清」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 打开 [open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py:893-910](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L893-L910)（`test_selects_only_the_final_eos_of_replay_documents`：9 个玩具文档一次覆盖所有边界情形）。
2. 准备一张三列表格：`文档` / `是否被规则选中` / `理由（对应规则的哪个条件）`。
3. 逐个填写那 9 个文档：聊天行 `[IM,10,11,EOS]`、回放 `[20,21,EOS]`、带内部 EOS 的 `[22,EOS,23,EOS]`、非 EOS 结尾的 `[24,25]`、单 token 的 `[EOS]` 和 `[26]`、两 token 的 `[27,EOS]`、多轮聊天行、以及只有一个 im_start 的 `[IM]`。

**预期结果**：被选中的恰好是「回放 + EOS 结尾 + 长度 ≥ 2」的三个文档；`(tokens[positions] == EOS).all()` 成立。测试是现成的断言，你只是在纸上复算它。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：文档 `[7, EOS, 8, EOS]`（回放，内部含 EOS）会被清哪个位置？内部那个 EOS 呢？

答案：只清 `end - 1`，即**最后一个** EOS 的 label；内部那个 EOS 的 label 保留。内部 EOS 处的前文是文档自己的内容，它是合法的内容监督；「教会停机」的监督只来自文档末位那个 EOS。

**练习 2**：为什么不干脆把回放文档末尾的 EOS **token 从数据里删掉**，一步到位？

答案：token 流是打包、文档边界、数据顺序与所有校验哈希的公共基础。删一个 token 会让其后所有偏移移位、manifest 与 `.csv.gz` 全部作废、`tokens_sha256` 全部失配；在 EOS 扫描边界模式下 EOS 还是文档分隔符，删了它文档会互相粘连。而清 label 只翻转监督位，token 一位不动——这是「最小干预」：修的只是 loss，不是数据本身。

**练习 3**：聊天缓存的 mask 本来就有 0（prompt 部分），为什么回放目录的 mask 是全 1 也不算 bug、却偏偏末位 EOS 出事？

答案：回放数据按预训练惯例「每个 token 都是目标」，全 1 是**有意为之**——预训练式文本本来就该整段预测。出事的不是全 1 本身，而是「以 EOS 结尾的文档 + 全 1」这个组合：它把「何时停止」的监督塞进了本该只学内容的长文本里。聊天行的回合末 EOS 是我们**想要**的停止监督，回放文档的末位 EOS 是**不想要**的，所以修复按开头 token 区分二者。

### 4.2 replay_final_eos_positions：判定核心的纯函数

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

[open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:663-682](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L663-L682)（`replay_final_eos_positions`：输入 token 数组与文档边界数组，输出要清的 label 位置）是整个修复的核心。它被设计成**纯函数**：numpy 数组进、numpy 数组出，无任何文件 IO。这个设计有两个直接好处：

1. 可以单独用一组玩具文档测试判定的每个分支（4.1.4 做的事）；
2. writer 与任何外部核对者都能对同一份数据独立复算它——4.4 的核对脚本干脆**不复用**它，而是按构建清单自己重推期望结果，两边对照。

它的 docstring 还写明了本讲最关键的一句话：mask 按目标 token 索引，所以在 `end - 1` 处清位，删掉的恰好是「由同一文档前一个 token 预测该 EOS」的那个目标——这正是 H270 要去掉的那条监督。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

函数三步走（全部向量化，无 Python 循环）：

```
输入: token_ids[T], document_bounds[N,2]（每行 [start, end)，整文档边界）
1. 长度过滤:  ends - starts >= 2          # 丢掉单 token 文档
2. 选择:      token_ids[starts] != im_start  且  token_ids[ends-1] == eos
3. 输出:      ends[selected] - 1          # 每个入选文档一个位置
```

为什么输入必须是**整文档边界**？docstring 的最后一行点破：「an EOS-scan or a part cut would make an interior EOS look final」。两种错误的边界来源：

- **EOS 扫描**（`--no_document_boundaries_from_metadata` 模式的做法）：把文档内每个 EOS 都当成边界，于是内部 EOS 会被切成「伪文档的末位 EOS」，进而被清掉合法的内容监督；
- **part 截断**：把 part 文件尾巴当成文档末尾，截断点附近的 token 会被误判。

所以调用方（writer）必须传入**构建清单给出的整文档边界**，函数本身不做任何边界推断。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

```python
def replay_final_eos_positions(token_ids, document_bounds, eos_token_id, im_start_token_id):
    starts, ends = document_bounds[:, 0], document_bounds[:, 1]
    long_enough = ends - starts >= 2
    starts, ends = starts[long_enough], ends[long_enough]
    selected = (token_ids[starts] != im_start_token_id) & (token_ids[ends - 1] == eos_token_id)
    return ends[selected] - 1
```

见 [open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:678-682](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L678-L682)（函数体：先按长度过滤，再用花式索引同时检查每个文档的首 token 与末 token，返回入选文档的 `end - 1`）。注意两个细节：

- `[start, end)` 是左闭右开区间，文档最后一个 token 的下标是 `end - 1`，因此返回值是 `ends - 1`；
- `token_ids[starts]` 与 `token_ids[ends - 1]` 是对**同一批文档**并行的两次花式索引，之后按位与——一次向量化完成全部判定。

配套测试 [open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py:892-910](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L892-L910)（`TestReplayFinalEosPositions`：9 个文档拼接成一条 token 流，用 `np.cumsum` 手工拼出边界，断言选中的正是那三个位置且选中位置的 token 全是 EOS）。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用一个手工小例子完整推演一遍「token 分 part + 文档边界 → 选中位置」。

**操作步骤**：拿出纸笔，构造**两个 part、三个文档**（玩具 id 沿用测试：`IM = 3`、`EOS = 2`）：

- part `0000`：文档 A = 聊天行 `[IM, 10, 11, EOS]`（start=0, end=4）；文档 B = 回放 `[20, 21, 24]`（start=4, end=7，注意它**不以 EOS 结尾**）；
- part `0001`：文档 C = 回放 `[30, 31, EOS]`（start=0, end=3）。

对每个 part 分别模拟函数三步：

1. part 0000 的 token 流是 `[3,10,11,2,20,21,24]`，边界 `[[0,4],[4,7]]`。长度过滤：4≥2、3≥2 都保留。选择：`tokens[0]=3` 等于 IM → A 出局；`tokens[4]=20` 不等于 IM，但 `tokens[7-1]=24` 不等于 EOS → B 出局。**返回空**。
2. part 0001 的 token 流是 `[30,31,2]`，边界 `[[0,3]]`。`tokens[0]=30` 不是 IM、`tokens[3-1]=2` 是 EOS → 选中，**返回 `[2]`**。
3. 串起来：整个目录只有 part 0001 的下标 2 这一个位置会被清。若源 mask 全 True，则 `dropped = 1`；part 0000 的输出 mask 与源逐字节相同。

**需要观察的现象**：聊天行 A 的末位 EOS 完好保留（它是要训练的停止监督）；B 因为结尾不是 EOS，什么也不发生；只有 C 的末位 EOS label 被清。

**预期结果**：positions = `{0000: [], 0001: [2]}`。把这个结果记下来——4.4 的综合实践会追问「如果这份目录喂给 check 脚本会怎样」，答案会出乎意料（见 4.4.5 练习 3）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：tokens = `[3,10,2, 20,2, 30,2]`，bounds = `[[0,3],[3,5],[5,7]]`。求 positions。

答案：文档 0 `[3,10,2]` 以 IM 开头 → 排除。文档 1 `[20,2]`：长 2、`tokens[3]=20` 不是 IM、`tokens[4]=2` 是 EOS → 选中，位置 `5-1=4`。文档 2 `[30,2]` 同理 → 位置 `7-1=6`。positions = `[4, 6]`，且 `tokens[4] = tokens[6] = 2`。

**练习 2**：如果有人把 bounds 换成 EOS 扫描的结果，`[22, EOS, 23, EOS]` 这个回放文档会出什么事？

答案：扫描会在内部 EOS 处把它切成 `[22,EOS]` 与 `[23,EOS]` 两段，两段都满足规则，于是**两个** EOS 的 label 都被清。内部 EOS 的监督是文档自身的内容，被错删；这就是 docstring 说「must be whole documents」的原因，也是 4.3 里把边界钉死到构建清单的原因。

**练习 3**：函数为什么自己不去读 `.csv.gz` 或 manifest，而非要调用方传边界进来？

答案：职责分离。判定函数只负责「给定边界，选哪些位置」；「边界从哪来、可不可信」是 writer 的安全责任（sha256 钉子 + 三方一致校验）。纯函数化还让它可以直接被单测覆盖，而不必先在磁盘上造假目录——`TestReplayFinalEosPositions` 全程没有碰文件系统。

### 4.3 mask_replay_final_eos.py 与构建清单：写掩码目录

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

writer 要解决的问题是**可信地知道每个文档的边界**。回放目录里的 `.csv.gz` 是训练真正读的边界，但它本身只是普通文件，没有任何东西证明「这就是构建当时写下的边界」。如果有人（或某个脚本）改写过 manifest 和 `.csv.gz`，让它们在内部 EOS 处把文档切开，两份文件会互相一致、却共同偏离构建事实——按它们清位就会错删内容监督。

所以 writer 把边界绑定到**构建清单**（build manifest）：`manifest.jsonl` 是回放构建逐文档写下的记录，而清单的可信度由**外部的 sha256 钉子**保证——CLI 默认要求它等于 `H182_REPLAY_MANIFEST_SHA256`（H182 那次构建的清单哈希，常数见 4.1.3）。writer 的 docstring 说得很直白：清单「must equal the .csv.gz rows and keep every document inside one part」，见 [open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:739-757](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L739-L757)（writer 的 docstring：声明 sha256 前置校验、清单必须与 csv 行一致且文档不跨 part、输出目录的构成与「源的统计不随迁」）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

writer `write_replay_eos_masked_dir` 分两大阶段，**先全盘校验、后落盘**，任何拒绝都发生在写任何字节之前：

```
SRC_DIR
├─ manifest.jsonl ──(存在性 + sha256 == 钉子)──> _replay_manifest_bounds
│                                              → {part 索引: (start,end) 行}
├─ token_ids_part_*.npy ─┐
├─ labels_mask_part_*.npy ┼─(四套索引集合必须一致: tokens/mask/csv/manifest)
├─ token_ids_part_*.csv.gz ┘
└─ 逐 part 校验(循环,全部通过才继续):
     1. mask 字节数 == token 数,token 字节数是它的 1/2/4/8 倍
     2. manifest 行铺满 part:首行 start=0,行间首尾相接,末行 end=token 数
     3. csv 行与 manifest 行逐行相等
     4. replay_final_eos_positions(tokens, bounds) → 该 part 的待清位置
     (收集进 plan;注释:"Positions first, so nothing is written for a dir that is refused.")
OUT_DIR = os.makedirs(out_dir)      # 已存在 → FileExistsError
├─ labels_mask_part_*.npy   每个 part:复制源 mask → 位置清 0 → flush
├─ token_ids_part_*.npy ┐
├─ token_ids_part_*.csv.gz ┼─ symlink → SRC 同名文件
├─ manifest.jsonl       ┘
└─ dataset_statistics.json  新写(见 4.5)
```

CLI 侧（`mask_replay_final_eos.py` 的 `main`）在写完之后立刻执行训练侧启动检查并对账，见 [scripts/data/mask_replay_final_eos.py:38-54](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/mask_replay_final_eos.py#L38-L54)（调用 writer 后，用 `oc_data.TokenizerConfig.dolma2()` 与 OLMo-core 的 dtype 规则跑 `_check_extra_numpy_dir`，再跑 `_check_row_aligned_cache`，若启动检查数出的 loss token 数与统计不符则抛错，最后打印变更摘要与 PASS 行）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**前置校验（先于一切写入）**：[open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:759-771](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L759-L771)（源目录 realpath 化、manifest 不存在即报错、按 16 MiB 块流式算 sha256、与钉子不符则报错——报错文本明确说「its boundaries cannot be tied to the replay build」）。sha256 在读任何 part 之前算完，这一步是整条信任链的锚点。

**索引集合一致性**：[open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:772-780](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L772-L780)（用 `_numpy_dir_parts` 列出 tokens/mask/metadata 三类文件，与 manifest 的 part 集合比对，四者不等则报错并列出各集合）。孤儿文件（如多余的 `labels_mask_part_0001.npy`）、缺 part、以及「一个文档横跨两个 part」的清单都会在这里现形——跨 part 文档的 manifest 只有一个 part 号，索引集合自然对不上。

**逐 part 校验与位置计划**：[open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:781-803](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L781-L803)（对每个 part：从 mask 文件字节数推出 token 数、验证 token 文件 dtype 是 uint8/16/32/64 的整倍；检查 manifest 行铺满该 part（首行起点 0、行间无缝、末行终点等于 token 数）；用 `_read_document_bounds` 读 `.csv.gz` 并要求与 manifest 行逐行相等；然后 `replay_final_eos_positions` 算出该 part 的待清位置，同时累计 documents/starting_im_start/not_ending_eos 三个透明度计数）。其中：

- `_numpy_dir_parts` 见 [open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py:685-693](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L685-L693)（用三个 glob 的正则把目录里的 part 文件按类别收进 `{类别: {索引: 路径}}`）；

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么所有校验（sha256、索引集合、铺满、csv 一致）必须发生在 `os.makedirs(out_dir)` 之前？

答案：让拒绝零副作用。数据是长跑训练的输入，一个半成品或错误目录被下游误用的代价远高于重跑一次脚本；代码里 `# Positions first, so nothing is written for a dir that is refused.` 的注释把这条原则写在了计划循环的位置上。`os.makedirs` 不带 `exist_ok` 则把「输出目录必须全新」也纳入同一原则。

**练习 2**：`--expected_manifest_sha256` 换一份新的回放目录时怎么用？钉子为什么放在 CLI 而不是库函数里写死？

答案：新目录的构建方需要提供自己 manifest 的 sha256，显式传给 `--expected_manifest_sha256`（或改默认值，像 H182 那样作为常量入库）。钉子本质是「构建事实的指纹」，它属于**运维层**的一次性约定，而 `write_replay_eos_masked_dir` 是通用库函数——把信任锚做成参数，函数才能服务任意构建，测试也才能对玩具目录「自钉」（`_masked` 辅助函数现场算 sha256，见 [test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py:922-928](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L922-L928)（测试辅助：默认用清单当前内容的 sha256 当钉子，或显式传入另一个））。

**练习 3**：源目录里那个 `stats.json` 为什么**不能**随迁到 OUT？

答案：它记录的是修复**之前**的统计（比如全部 token 可训练），对 OUT 来说是错的。writer 的统计必须按新 mask 重算（4.5）；测试明确断言 `stats.json` 不存在于 OUT，见 [test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py:959](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/open_instruct/test_numpy_dataset_conversion.py#L959)（断言 OUT 里没有源的 stats.json，注释说明源的计数在 OUT 中已失效）。

### 4.4 check_replay_eos_mask.py：独立核对

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

writer 说自己写对了，不算数。核对脚本的设计原则写在它的 docstring 第二段：**只用 numpy 和标准库，不碰任何写出 OUT 的代码**，见 [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:1-28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L1-L28)（CLI 文档串：说明用法、独立实现的原则、五组检查与 PASS 条件）。更关键的一句是「Replay documents are found from the replay build's inventory, **not from the rule under test**」——**期望值不来自被测的规则，而来自构建的独立记录**：manifest 的 sha256 + 来自构建 R2 回执的 `ids_sha256` / `rows` / `tokens` 四个钉子（PINS），见 [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:43-50](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L43-L50)（`h182` 的四元组钉子：清单 sha、id 列表 sha、行数 58,480、token 总数 2,678,796,581，文档串注明其与 ledger 的 r2_b1c12r.json 回执对应）。

所以它是一个「**机制检查**」（mechanism check）：它验证的是**数据变换这个机制**在真实数据上成立——每个清单文档都在声明的位置、内容哈希吻合、末位 label 在 OUT 中未训练、其他 label 一处不多一处不少、token 与边界原封未动、统计与启动检查的读法一致。它**不**证明「训练后的模型不再提前停机」——那是评测（checkpoint 质量评估）的事；也不复述 writer 的规则，而是从清单独立重推期望，因此**writer 规则写反、漏选、多选、写错文件**任何一种系统性错误都会被它抓到。用一句话：writer 与 checker 是两条独立实现 + 一份共同外部事实（构建回执），互为审计。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

docstring 列的五组检查，加上聊天目录与统计两块：

1. **文件层面**：SRC 与 OUT 各自的 token/mask/`.csv.gz` part 共享同一索引集合（等于清单的 parts），无孤儿 part 文件；OUT 的 token part、`.csv.gz` part 与 manifest 就是 SRC 的（realpath 相同或 sha256 相同）。
2. **边界层面**：每个 part 的清单行铺满它、且等于该 part `.csv.gz` 的行——训练读到的边界与清单一致，没有文档被切在两个 part 之间。
3. **清单层面**：每个清单文档恰好在它声明的位置被找到——长度等于 `length_with_eos`、末 token 是 EOS、前 `n-1` 个 token 的哈希等于 `tokens_sha256`；id 无重复、行数与 token 总数与钉子相符。
4. **掩码层面**：每个清单文档的末位 label 在 OUT 中未训练（SRC 训练过的计为 `dropped_at_final`，本来就没训练的计为 `already_untrained_at_final`，两者之和必须等于钉住的行数）；除此之外**没有别的 label 被清**（`cleared_elsewhere`）、**没有 label 被加回**（`labels_added`）、末位没有残留训练（`final_still_trained`）。
5. **统计层面**：每个 `.csv.gz` 行都是合法 `start,end`；OUT 的 `dataset_statistics.json` 能通过训练启动检查的读法——`row_aligned_parts` 为 true、`total_instances` 等于元数据行数、`trainable_tokens` 等于按 OUT 掩码实数的训练 token 数。

另加：每个 `--chat_dir`（与回放并列训练、修复不触碰的聊天缓存）行间铺满各 part 且**每行以 im_start 开头**——证明 H270 的规则在聊天缓存上本来也不会清任何东西；超过 `--max_seq_length` 的清单文档被计数（训练会截断它们，被清的 label 到不了任何 batch）。

PASS 条件与退出码：所有零计数器为 0、`found == pins["rows"]`、`dropped_at_final + already_untrained_at_final == pins["rows"]`，见 [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:260-264](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L260-264)（组装 PASS 布尔：全部零计数器为零且两个行数等式成立）；`main` 据此返回 0 或 1，并可把完整结果（含 per-part 计数）写进 `--out` JSON，见 [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:309-313](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L309-L313)（按需写 `--out` 文件、打印摘要、返回退出码）。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**零计数器**：[scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:57-78](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L57-L78)（定义 20 个必须为零的计数器名：从清单/回执失配、part 集合失配、文件不同、行不铺满、csv 与清单不同、畸形行，到统计缺失/不符、找不到文档、mask 非二值、错加、错清、末位残留、清单里出现 im_start 开头的文档、聊天行不以 im_start 开头）。注意两个「反向」计数器：`inventory_starting_im_start` 要求回放清单里**没有**聊天行混入，`chat_not_im_start` 要求聊天缓存里**所有**行都以 im_start 开头——两侧共同确认「回放 vs 聊天」的划分是干净的。

**钉子与文件枚举**：[scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:148-164](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L148-L164)（算 manifest 的 sha256 与钉子比对；读出清单后核对 id 列表 sha、行数、token 总数、id 重复；随后对 SRC 与 OUT 各跑一遍 `list_parts`，要求无孤儿文件且三类文件的索引集合等于清单的 part 集合）。`list_parts` 与 `csv_rows` 的实现见 [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:89-125](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L89-L125)（枚举 part 文件并识别孤儿；把 `.csv.gz` 解析成 `(start,end)` 行、数出畸形行数；docstring 注明 OLMo-core 解析不了畸形行而启动检查会把它数成一行）。

**逐 part 的清单核对**：[scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:178-198](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L178-L198)（以 mask 文件字节数为 token 数、按 token 字节数推出 uint 宽度打开 memmap；验证清单行铺满 part 且 `.csv.gz` 行与清单相等；然后逐文档验证「长度 == length_with_eos、末 token == EOS、去尾哈希 == tokens_sha256」，找到计 `found`、否则计 `not_found`）。注意它的 dtype 推导方式与 writer 不同但殊途同归——`token_memmap` 见 [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:109-111](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L109-L111)（按「token 文件字节数 ÷ mask 文件字节数」决定 uint 宽度打开只读 memmap）。

**掩码差分**——本脚本的灵魂：

```python
src, out = src != 0, out != 0
final = ends - 1
cleared = src & ~out
cleared[final] = False
part.update({
    "dropped_at_final": ..., "already_untrained_at_final": ...,
    "final_still_trained": int(out[final].sum()),
    "cleared_elsewhere": int(cleared.sum()),
    "labels_added": int((~src & out).sum()),
})
```

见 [scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:199-218](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L199-L218)（把两个 mask 读成布尔后做集合运算：末位上「SRC 训练 → OUT 不训练」计为 dropped，「SRC 本就不训练」计为 already untrained；末位之外的任何清零计 `cleared_elsewhere`，任何从 0 变 1 计 `labels_added`；同时验证 mask 是二值的）。三个方向各抓一种 writer 错误：漏清（`final_still_trained`）、多清（`cleared_elsewhere`）、错加（`labels_added`）。

**统计核对**：[scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py:241-258](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/095d931f5d2f3ffe02a682d272c012f4feb21767/scripts/data/check_replay_eos_mask.py#L241-L258)（按训练启动检查的读法核对 OUT 的 `dataset_statistics.json`：`row_aligned_parts` 必须为 true、`total_instances` 等于 OUT 所有 `.csv.gz` 的行数、`trainable_tokens` 等于按 OUT 掩码实数出来的训练 token 总数）。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践
